_about: Curation applied by phase7_fallback_literature.py (aggregate stage) to the raw abstract extraction. Every decision is recorded here rather than hand-edited into the CSV, so it is reversible and countable later (literature-target-map protocol, rule 4). Renames normalise a label onto an official HGNC symbol or onto the exact Phase 1b label for the same entity; they never merge two different entities. Drops remove a row from the candidate table on scope grounds; the claim stays in the work-directory caches. Paper flags do not remove anything - they mark rows whose every supporting paper carries the stated caveat.
